paper.title_en: Precision Solar System Dynamics for Ultralight Dark Matter Search
paper.abstract_en: Ultralight dark matter exhibits an order-one density fluctuation at the scale of its wavelength. This density fluctuation exists across the entire dark matter halo and interacts with stars and planets, perturbing their motion via gravitational interactions. We investigate the possibility of using precision solar system dynamics to search for ultralight dark matter. We examine this possibility with interplanetary radio range measurements. We show that the precision of current range measurements can probe ultralight dark matter at masses around $10^{-15}\,$eV, had its density in the solar system been $10^5$ larger than the so-called local dark matter density. This limit complements other constraints, such as the one from analyses of pulsar timing observations.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该文探讨利用太阳系精密测距（行星际无线电测距）搜寻超轻暗物质，并将其极限与脉冲星计时观测给出的限制进行比较，属于与脉冲星计时约束相关的暗物质探测研究，方法论清晰、可检验，值得进一步阅读。
decision.title_zh: 用于超轻暗物质搜寻的精密太阳系动力学
decision.abstract_zh: 超轻暗物质在其波长尺度上表现出量级为一的密度涨落。这种密度涨落存在于整个暗物质晕中，并通过引力相互作用与恒星和行星发生作用，扰动它们的运动。我们研究了利用精密太阳系动力学来搜寻超轻暗物质的可能性。我们借助行星际无线电测距测量来考察这一可能性。我们表明，如果太阳系中的暗物质密度比所谓的当地暗物质密度大$10^5$倍，那么当前测距测量的精度可以在质量约为$10^{-15}\,$eV处探测超轻暗物质。这一限制补充了其他限制，例如来自脉冲星计时观测分析的限制。
